Date: Tue, 7 Mar 2028 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Request: demo covering US/EU/APAC stakeholders

Hi Laura —

Thanks again for the intro last week. Aurora's platform team would like a 60–90 minute demo that includes: AE/SE walk-through, a short security Q&A (security team), and procurement/contract checklist (procurement). We have engineers in SF, Berlin and Singapore, so finding one window that everyone can attend is tough.

High-level asks:
- A technical demo focused on inference routing and failover (SE-led)
- A short security overview and SOC2 evidence request
- A follow-up procurement touchpoint to surface contract terms

Can you propose a few rotating windows (we're open to a rotation where different regions attend at different times weekly) or confirm which stakeholders should be present? Also attaching our internal requirements doc.

Attaching: aurora_requirements.pdf

Thanks,
Alex Chen

alex.chen@aurora-systems.com

Forwarding Aurora's request — can you and Diego draft a rotating-window plan and a tight agenda? Key constraints: 60 minutes demo + 30 minutes Q&A/security/procurement split, max 90 mins.

Initial constraints from my side:
- Diego: we want to show routing/fallback across regions and the Console trace for rollouts
- Security: bring SOC2 snapshot and a short compliance slide (10 mins)
- Procurement: outline typical timeline and PO process (Neha, can you draft a one-pager?)

Let's aim for three candidate weeks with 3 slot options each. Diego — would you prefer we propose a single-window rotation (same weekday/time shifting by zone) or three separate fixed windows?

Thanks — I'll include Alex once we have concrete slots.

— Laura Bennett

Laura / team —

I sketched a pragmatic rotation we can run for two weeks to cover all time zones without forcing a single impossible hour:

Option A — Week 1 (rotate by region):
- Tue 16:00 CET / 07:00 PT (EU + late US overlap) — primary audience: EU + some US engineers
- Thu 01:00 SGT / 08:00 CET / 23:00 PT (APAC-friendly) — primary audience: APAC + EU
- Fri 10:00 PT / 19:00 CET / 02:00 SGT (US morning primary; APAC watchers get recording)

Option B — Three fixed windows (same weekday each week):
- Wed 08:00 PT / 17:00 CET (balanced US morning / EU late afternoon)
- Thu 16:00 CET / 07:00 PT / 23:00 SGT (late APAC, early US)
- Tue 11:00 PT / 20:00 CET (US late morning / EU evening)

My preference: Option B with the Wed 08:00 PT slot as the default demo (good for engineering presence in SF + Berlin), and then rotate a Thu evening CET/SGT for APAC-heavy sessions. Keep the core demo 60 minutes: 35 min product + 15 min security + 10 min procurement/Q&A.

I also created a shared doc with time conversions and a one-click calendar poll: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2bAurora-demo-windows (please review).

Attachments: draft demo outline (I'll add slides for routing/fallback).

— Diego Fernandez
